products.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot Secure Adoption & Governance — Commercial
products.short_description: A repeatable way to adopt Microsoft 365 Copilot securely — remediate oversharing, apply sensitivity labels and DLP so Copilot respects them, tighten access, and put AI governance and a phased rollout in place. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Roll out Microsoft 365 Copilot without turning oversharing into a data breach

Microsoft 365 Copilot is only as safe as the data it can see — and it can see everything the user can. Turn it on before you've fixed oversharing, missing sensitivity labels, and weak access controls and it will happily surface confidential files, HR data, and stale content to anyone who asks. This solution gives you a repeatable way to adopt Microsoft 365 Copilot securely: assess and remediate oversharing, apply sensitivity labels and DLP so Copilot respects them, tighten access, and put AI governance and a phased rollout in place before you scale.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how Copilot accesses M365 data (the user's permissions + semantic index), the oversharing risk, how sensitivity labels and DLP constrain Copilot, the access-control and AI-governance model, and the phased adoption approach.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Copilot licensing, Microsoft 365 + Purview, Entra ID, SharePoint/OneDrive access review, sensitivity labels, a pilot group, governance owners) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: assess oversharing and access, remediate (restrict sharing, apply labels, clean up), configure DLP and label-based protections Copilot honors, set AI-governance guardrails and acceptable-use, pilot with a controlled group, validate, then expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Copilot-readiness + oversharing discovery, per-scope access/label validation, a data-exposure and readiness report, safe remediation of oversharing, and a Copilot pilot scope-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Microsoft 365 Copilot rolled out on a governed data estate — oversharing remediated, sensitivity labels and DLP enforced so Copilot respects them, access tightened, and AI-use governed — proven on a controlled pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • COPILOT-Discovery.ps1 — Copilot-readiness discovery: oversharing/access + label + readiness signals (Graph)
    • COPILOT-Remediation.ps1 — safe remediation of oversharing: remove anonymous/org-wide links (default -WhatIf)
    • COPILOT-Report.ps1 — data-exposure + Copilot-readiness report across sites and labels (Graph)
    • COPILOT-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — create the Copilot pilot scope group (idempotent)
    • COPILOT-Validation.ps1 — confirm remediation held: broad links removed, labels published, licensing pilot-only (Graph)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
